candidates.excerpt: Bihar BJP president Sanjay Saraogi criticised Rahul Gandhi’s proposed march to the Supreme Court, calling it an attempt to pressure the judiciary. He urged the INDIA bloc to file a legal petition instead, amid protests over alleged electoral roll irregularities

candidates.title: Nirmal Kumar Ridicules Stalin’s Remarks Of Victorious Defeat In By-Polls
candidates.excerpt: Minister C.T.R. Nirmal Kumar on Sunday ridiculed DMK president M.K. Stalin for his statement of ‘victorious defeat’ in the by-polls in the two constituencies and said it only showed the present state of the DMK which would face a similar situation as that of AIADMK in two years.
